issue_request: FHIR-29648 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Subscription clarification raised against R4. It requested a notice on the R4 Subscription page pointing implementers to the R5 Subscription redesign and/or the Subscription R5 Backport IG, with the accepted resolution to add a forward reference to the R5 backport IG as part of R4B publication.
initial_application: Commit 1fd27ca8041f9562e89d40fff53fc4391b70de66 applied the issue by adding a note and Backport Implementation Guide reference to source/subscriptions.html. That commit is contained in tag v5.0.0, matching the Jira applied-for R5 publication line.
additional_context: The current source still contains the requested notice at source/subscriptions.html:166-170. source/fhir.ini lists Subscription, SubscriptionStatus, and SubscriptionTopic as active resources, and current Subscription notes also retain a Backport IG link. FHIR-I minutes confirm the 2020 Persuasive vote; exact Zulip searching found no conflicting FHIR-29648 discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because no current source change is required. Adding another notice would duplicate existing current-source guidance.
